method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: A New Tax System (Medicare Levy Surcharge—Fringe Benefits) Act 1999, Compilation No. 42, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 58, 2026 (Register id C2026C00288), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00412.txt; no instrument sets its numbers (the $28,011 in ss 15(1)(c), 16(2)(c) is in its own text and is taken (INFERENCE) to be the 2025-26 figure, as in the Medicare Levy Act baseline); Private Health Insurance Act 2007 ss 22-30, 22-35, 22-40, 45-1 as deposited at ../../../private-health-insurance-act-2007/registers/source-bundle/C2007A00031.txt

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the taxpayer without private patient hospital cover who receives reportable fringe benefits: s 4 with PHI Act s 45-1 (hospital cover, excess $750/$1,500), s 5 (dependant, asked as a fact), s 6 with PHI Act s 22-30 as s 6(3) modifies it (tier 1-3 earners; indexed tier thresholds and the s 22-40(4) child increase are inputs), s 7 (married: registered and de facto couples, s 7(1A) displacement, living apart, a spouse who died), s 8 (prescribed person, as days), s 10 (imposed on a resident's reportable fringe benefits total), s 11, s 12 (single, no dependants), s 13 with s 13(2) (single with dependants), ss 14-16 with s 14(2), s 15(2) and s 16(3) (married; $28,011 own-income floor; spouse's trust share): 1%/1.25%/1.5% of the reportable fringe benefits total for a whole year. Part-year surcharge (ss 12(3), 13(4), 16(4) formulas not deposited) and a married person's year before 2025-26 return 'Not in the deposited text'. Not encoded: ss 1, 2, 3(2), 9, 10(4), the Subdiv 61-L offset, the s 271-105(1) trust assumption, rounding.
seat: the taxpayer without private patient hospital cover who receives reportable fringe benefits
